# World Stock News - Financial Intelligence & Stock Market News

> World Stock News is an institutional-grade, real-time stock market news, financial telemetry, and equities analysis publication. It provides live financial quotes, macroeconomic intelligence, Federal Reserve rate analysis, and crypto asset telemetry powered by open global APIs.

## Primary Sections & Live Feeds

- [Live Market Terminal & Tickers](https://worldstocknews.online/): Real-time streaming quotes for S&P 500 (^GSPC), Nasdaq 100 (^NDX), Dow Jones (^DJI), Russell 2000 (^RUT), Bitcoin (BTC-USD), Crude Oil, Gold Spot, and 10-Yr US Treasury Yields.
- [XML Sitemap](https://worldstocknews.online/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all published market analyses and category archives.
- [RSS 2.0 Feed](https://worldstocknews.online/feed.xml): Google News and RSS reader syndication wire.
- [JSON Feed](https://worldstocknews.online/feed.json): Clean JSON 1.1 feed for AI agents and programmatic parsers.
- [Full LLM Context Guide](https://worldstocknews.online/llms-full.txt): Complete uncompressed textual knowledge base and full-article content.

## In-Depth Analysis & Intelligence Deep Dives

- [Three Big Takeaways from the IMF-World Bank Meetings](https://worldstocknews.online/article/three-big-takeaways-from-the-imf-world-bank-meetings-3a6m): Macroeconomic debt analysis, AI policy impact, and global financial leadership shifts.
- [Why This Hedge Fund Approach May Deliver an Advantage Over Bonds](https://worldstocknews.online/article/dead-money-for-a-decade-why-this-hedge-fund-approach-may-del-3a6m): Strategic asset allocation, managed futures exposure, and fixed-income portfolio rebalancing.
- [SpaceX Earnings & AI Capital Allocation](https://worldstocknews.online/article/spacex-earnings-will-be-all-about-ai-for-better-or-for-worse-3w4r): Commercial space telemetry, infrastructure investment, and AI computing capex.
- [US Treasury Financing Plans & Wall Street Liquidity](https://worldstocknews.online/article/why-the-treasurys-financing-plans-are-sparking-anxiety-on-wa-3w4r): Debt issuance schedule analysis, bill-to-bond ratios, and sovereign duration dynamics.
- [Anthropic IPO Prospectus & AI Software Consolidation](https://worldstocknews.online/article/anthropic-is-ai-trades-last-big-hope-for-a-major-ipo-this-ye-3w4r): AI foundation model economics, public market valuation multiples, and tech liquidity events.
- [Fintech Product Evolution & Consumer Sentiment](https://worldstocknews.online/article/fake-shopping-sprees-and-happiness-insurance-the-latest-fint-w2jw): Behavioral finance trends, consumer debt telemetry, and emerging savings technology.

## Interactive Tools & Calculators

- [Compound Stock Investment Calculator](https://worldstocknews.online/#toolsSection): Interactive compound portfolio ROI calculator with monthly contribution modeling.
- [Fear & Greed Index Gauge](https://worldstocknews.online/#telemetryGrid): Real-time market sentiment dial combining momentum, breadth, and volatility indicators.
- [High-Impact Economic Calendar](https://worldstocknews.online/#calendarSection): Consensus forecasts and release schedules for US CPI, FOMC decisions, Retail Sales, and tech earnings calls.

## API Architecture & Data Sources

- **Frankfurter Open API**: Live foreign exchange currency rates against USD without authentication or rate walls.
- **CoinGecko Public API**: Real-time cryptocurrency quotes, 24-hour deltas, and capitalization rankings.
- **Financial Wire RSS Aggregators**: Real-time syndicated feeds from Yahoo Finance, MarketWatch, and SEC filings.
- **Micro-Tick Simulator**: High-frequency order-book simulation engine providing realistic intra-second volatility and pricing.
